The 23rd Lux Style Awards is a digital award show honouring the fashion, film, television, and music industries of Pakistan for the year 2023, spanning in 30 categories. Presented by Sarmad Khoosat, it was released on social media, days after the nominations were revealed on 5 April 2025.
It was also reported that the ceremony would be held in Lahore on 7 May, however, it was cancelled due to the 2025 India–Pakistan conflict.
